values.goal: Freeze an exact distributed qualification contract before provisioning nodes or injecting faults.
values.required_outcome: topology scenario fault timing resource receipt and claim contract is produced at an exact revision and independently reproducible.
declared_scope: Topology, identities, ports, state roots, credentials, transport, AWS/Wuji placement, scenarios, timing, resource budgets, receipt schema, cleanup, and claim boundaries.
authority_boundary: Issue DRT-01 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
Bind only after typed doctor reports ready
Do not cross dependency or stop gates
Keep evidence producer-derived and exact-revision bound
